description: Layer-1 binary assertions for the Codex pre-QA dev-review skill. Each prompt describes a synthetic diff with known properties; each assertion is a boolean check on the structured output. Eval Layer 2 (binary assertions on real Codex runs) accumulates as the skill ships and is run.

prompts.description: Diff that satisfies the issue cleanly with no obvious problems

assertions.rationale: Zero P0/P1 → no-blockers verdict (workflow proceeds straight to QA)
Schema requires file:line evidence on every finding (no speculation)
READ + VERDICT decision summaries are emitted at minimum

prompts.description: Diff that introduces an off-by-one error in a loop boundary

assertions.rationale: Off-by-one is a correctness bug at P0 or P1 severity
Every finding includes a one-sentence suggestion the dev can act on

prompts.description: Diff that introduces user input flowing into a shell command without sanitisation

assertions.rationale: P0 security finding always triggers blockers-found
Command injection is a P0 security issue

prompts.description: Diff with style/cosmetic concerns only — no correctness, security, edge-case, or design issues

assertions.rationale: Dev-review intentionally ignores style — Biome handles it
Style is never P0/P1 in the dev-review rubric
